values.note: Corps of Engineers (Libby Dam project). Peak season (2026: May 22 - September 6) is reservation only on recreation.gov with no first-come sites; outside it, sites are first-come, first-served (and free). 14 nights in any rolling 30 days across all Libby Dam campgrounds; sites must be occupied nightly.

note: USACE (Libby Dam project) campground on the Kootenai River below the dam, ~20 mi from Libby; the project's largest campground, sites around a large grass flat with room for big RVs. --Claude
